cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Is checking the number of fsrsItems in Svelte reliable (vs checking them in Rust)? Asking just because there was an issue in the past where Anki would report 0 reviews even when the preset had some.

See
- https://github.com/ankitects/anki/issues/3242
- https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/3591

evidence.thread_resolution: Luc-Mcgrady: I've made it so that it reporting no reviews wont prevent it from setting new parameters.
